The '''2018 Copa Libertadores group stage''' was played from 27 February to 24 May 2018.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2018_cla_cs.pdf|title=EL CALENDARIO DE AMBOS TORNEOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2018 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2018 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2018-espanol.pdf|title=Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish|access-date=2017-12-31|archive-date=2018-05-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180516165759/http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2018-espanol.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw /><noinclude>
The draw for the group stage was held on 20 December 2017, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/proceso-de-acreditacion-medios-de-prensa-para-el-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol|title=Proceso de acreditación a medios de prensa para el sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=12 December 2017}}</ref><ref name="draw1">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/los-grupos-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2018|title=Los Grupos y emparejamientos de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=20 December 2017}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL ranking of the Copa Libertadores'' (shown in parentheses), taking into account of the following three factors:<ref name="conmebol ranking">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/ranking-conmebol-libertadores2018|title=Ranking CONMEBOL Libertadores 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 2008–2017
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 1960–2007
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years
</noinclude>
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H, also denoted as Groups 1–8) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.<ref name="draw system">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sorteos_libertadores_sudamericana_2018_.pdf|title=Esquema de sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams were ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss). If tied on points, the following criteria were used to determine the ranking: 1. [[Goal difference]]; 2. Goals scored; 3. Away goals scored; 4. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 28).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2018 Copa Libertadores final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2018 Copa Libertadores final stages|knockout stages]]. The third-placed teams of each group entered the [[2018 Copa Sudamericana second stage|Copa Sudamericana second stage]].<section end=Format />

==Groups==
The fixture list was determined by the draw as follows:<ref name="draw system"/>
*'''Round 1''': Team 3 vs. Team 1, Team 4 vs. Team 2
*'''Round 2''': Team 1 vs. Team 4, Team 2 vs. Team 3
*'''Round 3''': Team 2 vs. Team 1, Team 3 vs. Team 4
*'''Round 4''': Team 1 vs. Team 2, Team 4 vs. Team 3
*'''Round 5''': Team 4 vs. Team 1, Team 3 vs. Team 2
*'''Round 6''': Team 1 vs. Team 3, Team 2 vs. Team 4

The matches were played on 27–28 February, 1, 13–15 March, 3–5, 11, 17–19, 24–26 April, 1–3, 15–17 and 22–24 May 2018.<ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/programa-de-partidos-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2018|title=Programa de partidos de la CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 December 2017}}</ref><ref name="fixture_pdf">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/programa_de_partidos_conmebol_libertadores_2018.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture-libertadores2018-6.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS FASE DE GRUPOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
